review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines three problem-specific real-valued slacks (firstActiveFailureSlack, secondActiveFailureSlack, thirdActiveFailureSlack). It also proves positivity and nonnegativity lemmas and an identity linking them to weightedPairScore. I checked the supporting definitions (weightedPairScore, matchedChildAverage, incidenceChild, diagonalMatchingReducedSlack). They are all specific to the six-point Besicovitch setting and are built from dist and norm. I found no Mathlib, Batteries or core concept that these slacks duplicate. firstActiveFailureSlack is a deliberate named alias of diagonalMatchingReducedSlack, which is a local naming choice and not a Mathlib duplicate. The two combination lemmas are standalone theorems, which the rubric excludes. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively, so a very obscure overlap is possible but unlikely.
